## Before submitting

- [x] I agree to license this contribution under the terms of [LICENSE.txt](https://github.com/NVIDIA/cudnn-frontend/blob/develop/LICENSE.txt).
- [x] I ran `pre-commit run` and committed any formatting changes.
- [x] I reviewed the Hard Rules in the `AGENTS.md` for each directory this PR touches (see [root AGENTS.md § Reviewing a PR](https://github.com/NVIDIA/cudnn-frontend/blob/develop/AGENTS.md#reviewing-a-pr-human-or-agent)) and my changes comply, or I explain the exception below.
- [x] I added GitHub labels: one `cat-*`, one or more `area:*` / `op:*`, and one `orig-*` (see [label list](https://github.com/NVIDIA/cudnn-frontend/labels)).

## Affected area

FE OSS kernels or CuTeDSL (FROST SDPA forward default placement; no kernel change).

## Summary

`_place_sm107_fp8` (#1684) gains a d128 arm. On exact cc 10.7, a dense per-tensor E4M3 d128 chunk (s_q < S_kv) puts FROST ahead of the backend when the GQA group is a power of two (so the Q tile packs it) and one of the following holds:

- **bottom-right causal**, s_q <= 512, and either S_kv >= 8192, or S_kv >= 4096 and S_kv >= 64 s_q;
- **mask-free**, s_q <= 128, and S_kv on the KV tile (`_synth_kv_padding` false).

Everything else at d128 keeps the backend first: squares, top-left causal chunks, unpackable groups, and the features #1684 already excludes. d192 is unchanged (backend first).

## Why

**The backend loses badly on these shapes.** On Rubin, the backend's bottom-right causal FP8 plan does not split KV at short s_q (#1788): q16 kv128k runs 737 us at both 8/1 and 64/8 heads. FROST runs the same graphs in 29 us and 101 us. That shape is decode-verify and chunked prefill, so this is the default path for those workloads.

**Placement A/B.** Same method as #1684 (`ab.py`: same graph on both arms with Amax_S virtual, CUDA-graph replay, two rounds with the arm order swapped, warm and cold L2; cc 10.7, 216 SMs, cuDNN 9.27.0.42). Lead-loss means FROST leads while slower than the backend by > 3 % warm or cold.

| set | cases | led | regret, develop -> PR | led graphs, FROST / backend | lead-losses |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| fit grid (s_q 16-2048, S_kv 1k-128k, 8/1, 64/8, 32/4 b4, 8/1 b8; causal-BR and mask-free) | 184 | 104 | 137.5 % -> 7.8 % | 0.04-0.97 | 0 |
| hold-out 1 (random, unaligned lengths) | 60 | 13 | 95.7 % -> 27.0 % | 0.09-0.55 | 0 |
| hold-out 2 (random, more head configs) | 100 | 29 | 82.0 % -> 23.9 % | 0.15-1.01 | 0 |
| **hold-out 3 (fresh, measured after freezing; groups 1-16 incl. 3/5/6/12)** | 100 | 30 | 78.4 % -> 23.4 % | 0.15-0.97 | 0 |

Each of the first two hold-outs changed the rule once:

- **Hold-out 1: mask-free graphs.** A mask-free graph off the KV tile cannot split and ran 2-5x slower, so mask-free now leads only on the tile.
- **Hold-out 1: s_q above 512.** Above 512, FROST's 512-row cluster doubles its wave count before the backend's does. b8 8/1 q576-768 kv13k ran 1.76x, the same at split 1/2/3/4 and with or without Stats, and recovered to 0.93 at q >= 896. Hence s_q <= 512.
- **Hold-out 1: short caches.** The KV/Q-ratio clause got a 4096 floor (b2 40/8 q29 kv3246: 1.05x).
- **Hold-out 2: GQA groups 5 and 6.** These do not divide the Q tile, run unpacked, and lost 1.3-1.75x at b > 1. Hence power-of-two groups only.

Hold-out 3 was generated and measured after the rule was frozen.

The s_q > 512 wave cliff is a FROST kernel/heuristic gap (the cluster size, not placement), as is the d192 loss at b·h_q >= 128 (1.25-1.82x). Both are left out of the lead set rather than worked around.

## Related issues

Follow-up to #1684. Related to #1788 (backend bottom-right causal short-s_q KV split).

## API and compatibility impact

Default plan selection only, for cc 10.7 per-tensor FP8 d128 forward chunks. No public API change.

## Testing

- New `test_sm107_fp8_d128_chunk_placement_structure`. Every bound is read from the module, so it pins the gate's structure, not a measured boundary. It covers: leads at the bounds; trails past s_q, below the cache bounds, on squares, for group 6, for top-left causal, and for mask-free off the tile.
- The existing d128-square TRAIL assertions in the #1684 tests still hold.
- The FE implementation and the offline scorer agree on all 588 measured cases.
- Local CPU: `pytest sdpa/frost/test_sdpa_fwd_placement.py -m L0`: 284 passed.
- GPU suites: CI.

+def test_sm107_fp8_d128_chunk_placement_structure():
+    """The d128 chunk arm reads every bound from the module, so this pins the gate's structure, not a measured boundary."""
+    from cudnn.sdpa.fwd.engines import ENGINE_SPECS
+
+    spec = next(s for s in ENGINE_SPECS if s.name == "sdpa_fwd_prefill_sm107_fp8")
+    long_kv, max_q = placement.SM107_FP8_D128_LONG_KV, placement.SM107_FP8_D128_CAUSAL_MAX_S_Q
+    chunk = {**_SM107_FP8_DENSE, **_SM107_FP8_QUANT, "d_qk": 128, "d_v": 128, "b": 1, "h_q": 64, "h_kv": 8, "s_q": max_q, "s_kv": long_kv}
+    place = lambda **over: placement.place(spec, _facts(device_cc=(10, 7), **{**chunk, **over}))
+    assert place() == placement.LEAD
+    assert place(s_q=max_q + 1) == placement.TRAIL
+    assert place(s_kv=long_kv - 128) == placement.TRAIL  # below the long cache and under the KV-per-Q ratio
+    ratio_q = placement.SM107_FP8_D128_MIN_KV // placement.SM107_FP8_D128_KV_PER_Q
+    assert place(s_q=ratio_q, s_kv=placement.SM107_FP8_D128_MIN_KV) == placement.LEAD
+    assert place(s_q=ratio_q, s_kv=placement.SM107_FP8_D128_MIN_KV - 128) == placement.TRAIL
+    assert place(s_q=long_kv, s_kv=long_kv) == placement.TRAIL  # square
+    assert place(h_q=48, h_kv=8) == placement.TRAIL  # GQA group 6 cannot pack
+    assert place(bottom_right=False) == placement.TRAIL  # top-left causal chunks were not measured
+    free = {"causal": False, "bottom_right": False, "s_q": placement.SM107_FP8_D128_MASKFREE_MAX_S_Q}
+    assert place(**free) == placement.LEAD
+    assert place(**{**free, "s_kv": long_kv + 1}) == placement.TRAIL  # off the KV tile: the mask-free graph cannot split
+    assert place(**{**free, "s_q": placement.SM107_FP8_D128_MASKFREE_MAX_S_Q + 1}) == placement.TRAIL
